name: Bob Velseb
source:
Bob Velseb, also known as his alias The Devil, was a cannibalistic serial killer who first appeared in It’s spooky month, and later returns as the main antagonist of Spooky Month - Tender Treats. He wears a costume that looks like a Red Demon.
Comes from YouTube web series created by SrPelo

[From: [url=https://srpelo-spookymonth.fandom.com/wiki/Bob_Velseb]Spooky Month Wiki Fandom[/url]]
